label: ercot37 g22 surface on
definition: (PROBE — REJECTED) G-22 condition-responsive CT/peaker offer surface ON: raises CT econ+peak tranche bids to the measured 60-Day-DAM self-withholding level (~$1,500 cap band) above the 90th net-load percentile. Confirms the wedge is not purely offer-height: needs commitment-thinness / heterogeneity-preserving surface (filed). Keeper stays ercot34; mechanism stays default-off (rules 1/11/26).
